content: We describe the details of our approach in Section SECREF2 , then evaluate it in terms of performance in grammatical error correction in Section SECREF3 and in style transfer in Section SECREF4 . The paper ends with a review of related work in Section SECREF5 and conclusions in Section SECREF6 .
